notes:
ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP only (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124), no block encountered on any of 138 requests (homepage + robots.txt + 137 leaf category pages, all HTTP 200); Playwright/CDP and Claude-in-Chrome were not needed. robots.txt (https://www.ikea.com/robots.txt; the ae/en path itself 404s and defers to the global file) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry and no blanket 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /' - only specific query-param/search/cart/checkout/fragment paths are disallowed, none of which were used. TREE: Built from the site's own 'catalogSlim' JSON array embedded inline in the homepage HTML (https://www.ikea.com/ae/en/) - this mirrors the exact IKEA.ae mega-menu, with nested 'subs' arrays down to leaf category pages. This is the same mechanism used for the sibling IKEA storefronts (SR92 UK, SR107 DE) in this project; the AE catalogSlim tree is structurally near-identical to both (same category IDs/slugs almost throughout, e.g. tl001 Textiles & rugs, tl002 Window treatments, st001 Storage & organisation, st007 Small storage & organisers), confirming this is the same global IKEA taxonomy localised for the AE storefront, not independently re-derived. Roots crawled: Textiles & rugs (tl001), Window treatments (tl002), Storage & organisation (st001), Small storage & organisers (st007), plus the storage-relevant subset of Bathroom products (ba001) and Laundry & cleaning (lc001) for bathroom/laundry storage items that only nest under those roots, and the storage-relevant subset of Baby & children (bc001) / Cookware & tableware (kt001) which turned out to be the identical node IDs already reached from st007 (Food storage & organising 15937, Children's storage & organisation 18706) - no new leaves found there, confirming no cross-root duplication was missed. QTY: extracted directly from each category page's rendered result-count element (

Showing N of TOTAL results

) via regex - this is the exact total IKEA.ae displays above the product grid (storage.md Sec.36 rule 2 pagination-total pattern), not paginated or estimated. Fetched via 10-way concurrent HTTP requests over the 137 curated leaf node IDs; every single one returned a valid count with HTTP 200, no manual-review fallbacks needed for quantity itself. Every leaf's rendered

and were captured and cross-checked against the requested node - all 137 matched exactly, confirming no leaf silently served a parent/sibling/site-wide total. EFFICIENCY ROLLUPS (matching UK/DE precedent for this very deep IKEA catalog): all 16 named modular storage systems (PAX, BESTA, PLATSA, EKET, SMASTAD, IVAR, BROR, BOAXEL, JONAXEL, JOSTEIN, TROFAST, ELVARLI, OLAUS, LODMAKARE, LASTARE, GULDDRAGARE) recorded at the system level (one row per system) rather than exploding into every combination/frame/door/part sub-page, since all sub-pages describe the same underlying storage-furniture product differing only by module/finish; Wardrobes (19053) similarly kept as one leaf rather than its 11 door/installation-style sub-pages and 3 accessory pages (shelving/lighting/sliding-doors). EXCLUDED (checked, not included): Curtain rods & rails and all curtain hardware (18891/18892/18893/18894/700426 - hardware, not fabric), Sewing accessories (14350, notions/tools not a fabric product), Window films & accessories (700628, adhesive film not textile), Venetian blinds (700599, slat blinds - not fabric/textile), Anti-slip & underlays (10699, rubber/PVC grip accessory not a rug/textile itself), Clothing & accessories (42925, apparel), Brackets (20659, mounting hardware), SKYTTA sliding door system (55984, a wardrobe/room-divider door-hardware system, not itself a storage container - matches SR107 DE's exclusion), BOAXEL system's appearance nested a second time under Wall shelves (47394/47395/47396 - recorded once only, at the Storage solution systems level), Bedside tables (20656) and Dressing tables (20657, surface furniture, not storage - matches SR92 UK exclusion), Sideboards, buffets & console tables (30454, a cross-cutting collection hub duplicating the narrower Sideboards & buffets 10412 plus non-storage Console tables 16246 - matches SR92 UK's exclusion of the equivalent node), TV & media furniture's parent grouping kept but Kitchen islands & trolleys (10471, kitchen serving furniture) excluded from the Trolleys node while Bathroom trolleys (20858) kept, Room dividers (46080) and Hallway furniture sets (700411, mixed furniture sets - both match SR92 UK exclusions), Noticeboards (10574) and Hangers (20618, not a storage container - match SR92 UK exclusions), Recycling bins / waste-paper & pedal bins / bin bags (34470/16215/16214/16213, waste disposal not organisational storage of belongings - matches SR92/SR107 exclusion), personal-carry Bags (Shopping/tote 16295, Backpacks 27821, Travel accessories 16255, Cool bags 46082 - fashion/travel carrying items excluded per storage.md Sec.6, only Bag organisers 47441 kept), Moving supplies (46078, packing materials not home storage), most of Bathroom accessories (Bathroom bins 48940, Soap dispensers & dishes 10656, Toilet brushes 48944, Toothbrush holders 48943 - hygiene fixtures not storage; Shower & bathtub accessories 10658 and Non-drill bathroom accessories 700699 were kept since these are genuine shower/bath caddies, matching SR107 DE's inclusion of the equivalent nodes), Bathroom stools & benches (20859, seating furniture), Drying racks (20602), Washing machines & tumble dryers (20826) and Ironing boards (20608, appliances/tools not storage - explicit storage.md Sec.11 exclusion), Dishwashing accessories (15938, cleaning tools), Cleaning accessories (20609, cleaning tools), Water bottle & travel mugs (700352, drinkware/travel not home storage), essentially all of Bathroom products (ba001) outside the storage-baskets/cabinets/shelving/laundry-storage/shower-caddy subset - mirrors, taps, sinks, showers, vanity units with/without basin, countertops, bathroom systems (HAVBACK/ANGSJON/TONNFORSEN/HEMNES/ENHET/NYSJON/VIDVESSEL), bathroom lighting - all fixtures or non-storage furniture per storage.md Sec.14/28. Duplicate cross-linked nodes (same category ID reachable from more than one menu path - e.g. Children's bed linen/cushions & blankets/wardrobes/chests of drawers appearing under both a top-level group and the Children's textiles/Children's storage & organisation hubs; Wall shelves reachable from both Bookcases & shelving units and Hooks & wall organisation; Laundry baskets/Laundry storage/Laundry accessories reachable from both Bathroom laundry ba003 and Laundry & cleaning lc001; Food storage & organising 15937 reachable from both st007 and Cookware & tableware kt001; Table linen 20538 reachable from both Textiles & rugs and Cookware & tableware) were each recorded exactly once under their single most specific/primary parent, never duplicated - zero duplicate links confirmed programmatically across both arrays. LOW-CONFIDENCE flags (4 total, review-queued per rule): Bathrobes, slippers & spa accessories (700339, mixed category also containing non-textile spa items); Lumbar support (700528, may be a wellness/health product rather than a home-textile cushion - same flag SR107 DE raised); Display shelves & picture ledges (16305, combined node, picture-ledge portion may be Wall Decor rather than Storage); Bathroom shelves & towel rails (20615, combined node, towel-rail portion is hardware not a storage container); Cable management & accessories (16195, borderline storage/organisation utility - same flag SR107 DE raised).
